title: Smallest Range II
description: Minimize the score (max - min) by adding or subtracting k from each element.
pseudocode:
1. nums.sort()
2. score = nums[last] - nums[0]
3. For i from 0 to n-1:
4.   high = max(nums[last]-k, nums[i]+k)
5.   low = min(nums[0]+k, nums[i+1]-k)
6.   score = min(score, high - low)
7. Return score

steps.note: Looping through indices to find minimized range.
